gloss: enough for the number of people; per-person portion

definitions.gloss: enough for the number of people; per-person portion; for everyone in the group
definitions.explanation: An amount or quantity sufficient for all the people present or involved. The suffix {分|ぶん} (portion, share) attaches to {人数|にんずう} (number of people) to indicate that something is prepared or available in the right quantity for the group.

examples.japanese: {人数|にんずう}{分|ぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コピー→コピー：04883_kopii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}した→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧。
{人数|にんずう}{分|ぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{椅子|いす}→椅子：00706_isu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: There aren't enough chairs for everyone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人数|にんずう}{分|ぶん}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{多|おお}め→多め：28421_oome⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧おいた⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: It's better to buy slightly more ingredients than needed for the number of people.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{人数|にんずう}→人数：03132_ninzuu⟧ (number of people) and ⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (portion, share, amount for). The ⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ suffix is very productive: ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (one person's portion), ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (for two people), ⟦{三日|みっか}→三日：02969_mikka⟧⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (three days' worth).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人数|にんずう}{分|ぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧: to prepare enough for everyone
- {人数|にんずう}{分|ぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧: meals for the whole group
- {人数|にんずう}{分|ぶん}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧: more than enough for the group
- {人数|にんずう}{分|ぶん}⟦{足|た}りる→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: to be enough for the number of people

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧: one person's portion — a specific single serving
- ⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧: for all members — emphasizes that every single member is included
- {頭数|あたまかず}: headcount — focuses on counting the people rather than the portions
